follow-up time: Duration of second stage of labor
exposure: hourly evaluation and documentation during the second stage of labor
Hourly evaluation and documentation during the second stage of labor
cohort: 1498 women who delivered at an urban, tertiary care hospital and had a second stage of labor longer than 60 minutes between June 1, 2016, and May 31, 2019
finding: Hourly evaluation and documentation during the second stage of labor was associated with decreased cesarean delivery rate, shorter second-stage labor duration, decreased blood loss, and lower hemorrhage rates.
mod_finding: Hourly evaluation and documentation during the second stage of labor was associated with a decreased likelihood of cesarean delivery.
